title: Number Play: Divisibility and Patterns
summary: Why divisibility tests work, sums of consecutive numbers, and reasoning about odd and even.

ib.note: Justifying patterns algebraically builds MYP Criteria B and C

objectives: I can use divisibility tests for 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10 and 11.
I can explain why some divisibility tests work.
I can investigate and justify number patterns.
misconceptions: Divisibility tests are just tricks with no reason.
If a number is divisible by 2 and 4, it must be divisible by 8.
Every number can be written as a sum of consecutive numbers.
